metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Go ahead, just blame the lag’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did that shot even have a target?
Enemy probably glitching out or just vanished.
Click if your aim’s a mystery but the game still hands out freebies.
Valorant logic in full trolling mode again.

Tap if your kills always come from pure chaos!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
